summary.text: Nolan Kemp is the Democratic candidate for Illinois House of Representatives District 74 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Brad Fritts (R).
In a Ballotpedia survey, Kemp listed affordability, public safety that protects civil liberties, and local jobs and housing as his key campaign messages.

paragraphs.text: Kemp won the March 17, 2026 Democratic primary without opposition.
In the Ballotpedia survey, he said he has a public safety background and is focused on property taxes, retirement security, and mental health and substance-use treatment.
